```{=html}
<!-- Code Courtesy of ChatGPT 6.1 -->
<div id="announcement-controls" hidden>
  <button type="button" id="announcement-previous">← Previous</button>
  <span id="announcement-count" aria-live="polite"></span>
  <button type="button" id="announcement-next">Next →</button>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const container = document.getElementById("announcements");
  const items = container.querySelectorAll(".announcement");
  const controls = document.getElementById("announcement-controls");
  const count = document.getElementById("announcement-count");
  let current = 0;

  if (items.length === 0) return;

  function showAnnouncement() {
    items.forEach((item, index) => {
      item.hidden = index !== current;
    });
    count.textContent = `${current + 1} of ${items.length}`;
  }

  document.getElementById("announcement-previous").addEventListener("click", () => {
    current = (current - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
    showAnnouncement();
  });

  document.getElementById("announcement-next").addEventListener("click", () => {
    current = (current + 1) % items.length;
    showAnnouncement();
  });

  showAnnouncement();
  controls.hidden = items.length < 2;
})();
</script>
```
